segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ED note said he ambulates independently with a cane and lives alone. That's a pretty common profile for us, so I had a sense of where this was probably headed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: An initial baseline is expressed, but this span alone does not establish failure to update.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Within that conversation I felt like I had a good read on him... my instinct said steady.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant expresses high confidence in a rapid mobility read before formal PT data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had already sort of built my plan around the independent-living picture, so those things registered more as things to keep an eye on rather than something that should make me start over.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The original independent-living description remains the reference point despite contradictory PT and nursing data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: From that, plus the fact he'd gone home successfully after two previous admissions, I moved forward planning for home with outpatient services.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A provisional plan is expressed without the explicit expectation-based interpretation required for eb_01.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was asking more 'how do we make this work' than 'can this actually work.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Follow-up questions favored implementing the home plan rather than testing caregiver adequacy.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Families usually do step up... So I took her willingness at face value as enough to build around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vague caregiver statement is interpreted as sufficient because similar families usually work out.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It did mean the coverage picture was thinner than what I'd been planning around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a non-biased acknowledgment of newly discovered coverage limits.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That case was still fresh, and honestly it's the first thing that came to mind when I was thinking through Hoffmann's risk.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vivid recent case shapes risk estimation before review of the patient's own data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Leaving the tool for later felt like the lower-stakes choice.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Omission of the available risk tool is treated as less consequential than active reassessment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The numbers didn't fully back up how worried I'd been feeling based on that other case.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is retrospective recognition of an objective-data mismatch, not a separate instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: There was a short-term rehab bed available... The alternative was finalizing home discharge that same day.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Options and constraints are described without the hidden affective-forecasting mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The frustration and the sense of being stuck here would carry over past the delay itself. So finishing the extra checks felt like it would cost more than it was worth.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant forecasts an extended distress reaction and uses it to reject completing verification.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: He was distressed even talking about waiting a day, and I didn't want to put him through that.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Patient distress is a legitimate consideration here; overestimation is not independently established in this span.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If I'd pushed harder on specifics with the daughter earlier instead of assuming it would work out, we might have caught the coverage gap sooner.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a retrospective process reflection, not a new occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Run the risk tool earlier, and ask more direct questions about caregiving capacity.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Corrective intentions are not separately scored as bias occurrences.
